Successfully configured VLC media player to allow pausing/starting the video with a global keyboard shortcut without needing to switch focus from the PDF reader.

**Configuration Details:**
- **Global Hotkey Set:** Ctrl+Alt+Space
- **Action:** Play/Pause
- **Location:** Tools > Preferences > Hotkeys tab

The global hotkey will work even when VLC doesn't have focus, allowing you to control the video playback while keeping your attention on the lecture notes in the PDF reader. You can now press Ctrl+Alt+Space at any time to pause or resume the video without switching applications.
